source.name: Opening a drawer must move keyboard focus into it
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/43120) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Open the filters drawer and apply a filter with the keyboard
journey.goal: Opening the drawer moves focus into it, so the user can tick a filter and show results without a pointer

functionalJourney.title: Apply a filter with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking Filters, ticking Waterproof and clicking Show results applies the filter

guards.title: Escape closes the drawer and returns focus to Filters
guards.goal: After opening the drawer with the pointer, Escape closes it and focus is back on the Filters button

plan.root_cause: When the drawer is opened via the button, focus remains on the triggering button instead of moving inside the drawer, preventing keyboard users from interacting with the filter controls.
plan.repair_strategy: Override the Drawer.show method to focus the close button (#filters-close) after the drawer is shown, ensuring initial focus is placed within the drawer for keyboard navigation.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Focus moves into the drawer when opened, allowing sequential tab navigation to the filter controls and apply button without requiring a pointing device.
functional_risks: If the element with id 'filters-close' is removed or becomes non‑focusable, focus will not be moved.
Overriding show may interfere with subclasses that rely on the original show timing.
verification_requirements: After activating the Filters button with Enter, focus is on #filters-close.
Pressing Tab twice moves focus to #apply.
Pressing Enter on #apply updates the applied output to 'in' and hides the drawer.
